title: 跟外國朋友介紹台灣
subtitle: 12 句英文，聊家鄉不再只會說「很台」

lines.say: So, Ting, what's Taiwan like? What do people do for New Year?
lines.zh: 小婷，台灣是什麼樣子？大家過年都做什麼？

lines.say: Em… we… eat. And… em… red envelope. It's… very… Taiwanese.
lines.zh: 呃……我們……吃東西。還有……呃……紅包。就……很……台灣。

lines.say: This is Ting again. She knows everything about Taiwan. But in English, it all came out as: it's very Taiwanese.
lines.zh: 又是小婷。她對台灣瞭若指掌，但用英文講出來，全部變成「就很台灣」。

lines.say: Explaining your own culture is hard, because you've never had to explain it before.
lines.zh: 介紹自己的文化很難，因為你從來不需要解釋它。

board.cta: 跟外國朋友介紹台灣・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today, Ting will learn twelve sentences for talking about home.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天小婷要學介紹家鄉的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today, Ting will learn twelve sentences for talking about home.

lines.say: Explaining customs, describing food, answering surprising questions, and asking about their culture too.
lines.zh: 解釋習俗、形容食物、回答意想不到的問題，還有反過來問對方的文化。

scenes.title: Customs
scenes.sub: 習俗：用對方懂的東西比喻

lines.say: Part one: explain a custom.
lines.zh: 第一段：解釋習俗。

lines.say: The trick is to connect it to something they already know.
lines.zh: 訣竅是把它連到對方已經知道的東西。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: Lunar New Year is a bit like Christmas here. Everyone goes home to their family.
scenes.meaning: 農曆新年有點像這裡的聖誕節，大家都回家團圓

lines.say: Lunar New Year is a bit like Christmas here. Everyone goes home to their family.
A bit like plus something they know. Now they understand straight away.
lines.zh: a bit like 加上對方知道的東西，對方馬上就懂了。

lines.say: Then add one detail that makes it real.
lines.zh: 接著加一個細節，讓它更具體。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Lunar New Year is a bit like Christmas here. Everyone goes home to their family.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: Older relatives give the kids money in red envelopes, for good luck.
scenes.meaning: 長輩會用紅包裝錢給小孩，討個吉利
scenes.note: for good luck ＝ 為了好運

lines.say: Then explain the custom. Who, what, and why.
lines.zh: 接著解釋這個習俗：誰、做什麼、為什麼。

lines.say: Older relatives give the kids money in red envelopes, for good luck.
Don't just say red envelope. Say who gives it, what's inside, and why.
lines.zh: 不要只說 red envelope，要說誰給、裡面是什麼、為什麼。

lines.say: For good luck is the why. People always want to know the why.
lines.zh: for good luck 就是原因，大家總是想知道為什麼。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Older relatives give the kids money in red envelopes, for good luck.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: There's no direct translation, but it means something like…
scenes.meaning: 沒有直接的翻譯，但意思大概是……
scenes.note: There's no direct translation ＝ 沒有直接的翻譯

lines.say: And when a word is impossible to translate, say this.
lines.zh: 遇到沒辦法翻譯的字，就這樣說。

lines.say: There's no direct translation, but it means something like…
Then explain the feeling, not the word.
lines.zh: 接著解釋那種感覺，而不是那個字。

lines.say: Foreigners love these words. They're the most interesting part!
lines.zh: 外國人超愛這種字，那是最有趣的部分！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: There's no direct translation, but it means something like…
Part two: talk about food.
lines.zh: 第二段：聊食物。

lines.say: Food is the easiest way into any culture. And everyone has an opinion.
lines.zh: 食物是進入任何文化最簡單的方式，而且每個人都有意見。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: You have to try stinky tofu. It smells awful, but it tastes amazing.
scenes.meaning: 你一定要試試臭豆腐，聞起來很可怕，但吃起來超讚
scenes.note: smells … but tastes … ＝ 聞起來……但吃起來……

lines.say: You have to try stinky tofu. It smells awful, but it tastes amazing.
You have to try is a strong, friendly recommendation.
lines.zh: You have to try 是強烈又友善的推薦。

lines.say: Smells awful, but tastes amazing. The contrast makes people curious.
lines.zh: 聞起來很可怕、吃起來超讚，這種反差讓人好奇。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: You have to try stinky tofu. It smells awful, but it tastes amazing.

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: It's the kind of thing you eat at a night market, late at night.
scenes.meaning: 那是你會在夜市、深夜吃的東西
scenes.note: the kind of thing ＝ 那種……的東西

lines.say: Then tell them when and where people eat it.
lines.zh: 接著告訴對方大家什麼時候、在哪裡吃。

lines.say: It's the kind of thing you eat at a night market, late at night.
The kind of thing you eat paints a picture. Now they can imagine it.
lines.zh: the kind of thing you eat 畫出一個畫面，對方就能想像了。

lines.say: Night markets are one of the best things to describe. Lights, noise, smells!
lines.zh: 夜市是最適合形容的東西之一：燈光、人聲、香味！

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: It's the kind of thing you eat at a night market, late at night.

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: If you like spicy food, you'd love Taiwanese beef noodle soup.
scenes.meaning: 如果你喜歡吃辣，你一定會愛台灣牛肉麵
scenes.note: If you like …, you'd love … ＝ 如果你喜歡……你一定會愛……

lines.say: And connect it to what they like.
lines.zh: 再把它連到對方喜歡的東西。

lines.say: If you like spicy food, you'd love Taiwanese beef noodle soup.
If you like, you'd love. A perfect way to recommend anything.
lines.zh: If you like, you'd love，推薦任何東西的完美句型。

lines.say: Now it's not just your culture. It's something for them.
lines.zh: 這樣它不只是你的文化，也變成對方會喜歡的東西。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: If you like spicy food, you'd love Taiwanese beef noodle soup.
Let's watch Ting try again.
lines.zh: 我們看小婷再試一次。

lines.say: So, what do people do for New Year in Taiwan?
lines.zh: 那台灣人過年都做什麼？

lines.say: Lunar New Year is a bit like Christmas here. Everyone goes home to their family.
lines.zh: 農曆新年有點像這裡的聖誕節，大家都回家團圓。

lines.say: Older relatives give the kids money in red envelopes, for good luck.
lines.zh: 長輩會用紅包裝錢給小孩，討個吉利。

lines.say: Money? I wish we did that in Italy!
lines.zh: 給錢？真希望義大利也這樣！

lines.say: Now he understands, and he wants to hear more.
lines.zh: 現在他懂了，而且還想聽更多。

scenes.title: Questions
scenes.sub: 被問倒時：好好回答意外的問題

lines.say: Part three: answer surprising questions.
lines.zh: 第三段：回答意想不到的問題。

lines.say: People will ask things you never expected. That's a good sign. They're interested!
lines.zh: 大家會問你完全沒想過的問題，這是好事，表示他們有興趣！

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.meaning: 其實那是很常見的誤解

lines.say: Actually, that's a common misconception.
When someone has the wrong idea, correct them gently with this.
lines.zh: 對方有錯誤印象時，用這句溫和地糾正。

lines.say: Common makes it kind. It means: lots of people think that, it's not your fault.
lines.zh: common 讓語氣很體貼：很多人都這樣想，不是你的錯。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Actually, that's a common misconception.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: Not exactly. It really depends on the family.
scenes.meaning: 不完全是，其實要看每個家庭

lines.say: And when the answer is: it's complicated, say this.
lines.zh: 答案是「很複雜」的時候，就這樣說。

lines.say: Not exactly. It really depends on the family.
Not exactly is softer than no.
lines.zh: Not exactly 比 no 柔和。

lines.say: It depends on the family. Because no country is just one way.
lines.zh: 要看每個家庭，因為沒有一個國家只有一種樣子。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Not exactly. It really depends on the family.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: Good question! I've never really thought about that.
scenes.meaning: 好問題！我從來沒想過這個
scenes.note: I've never really thought about ＝ 從來沒想過

lines.say: And when you just don't know, be honest.
lines.zh: 真的不知道的時候，就誠實說。

lines.say: Good question! I've never really thought about that.
This buys you time, and it's a compliment to their question.
lines.zh: 這句幫你爭取時間，也是在稱讚對方的問題。

lines.say: Nobody knows everything about their own country. That's OK.
lines.zh: 沒有人對自己的國家無所不知，沒關係的。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Good question! I've never really thought about that.
Part four: ask about their culture too.
lines.zh: 第四段：也問問對方的文化。

lines.say: A good culture chat goes both ways.
lines.zh: 好的文化交流是雙向的。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: Is there anything like that in Italy?
scenes.meaning: 義大利有類似的東西嗎？
scenes.note: anything like that ＝ 類似的東西

lines.say: Is there anything like that in Italy?
After you explain, turn it around. Now it's their turn to be the expert.
lines.zh: 你解釋完之後，把問題丟回去，換對方當專家。

lines.say: Anything like that works for food, festivals, anything.
lines.zh: anything like that 用在食物、節慶，什麼都可以。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Is there anything like that in Italy?

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: No way, we do something really similar!
scenes.meaning: 不會吧，我們也有很像的習俗！
scenes.note: something really similar ＝ 很像的東西

lines.say: And when you find something in common, say this.
lines.zh: 發現共同點的時候，就這樣說。

lines.say: No way, we do something really similar!
Finding something in common is the best moment in any culture chat.
lines.zh: 找到共同點是文化交流中最棒的時刻。

lines.say: It turns two strangers into two friends.
lines.zh: 兩個陌生人就這樣變成朋友。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: No way, we do something really similar!

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: You should come and visit some time. I'll show you around.
scenes.meaning: 你哪天應該來玩，我帶你到處逛
scenes.note: show someone around ＝ 帶某人到處參觀

lines.say: And the warmest way to finish.
lines.zh: 最溫暖的結尾。

lines.say: You should come and visit some time. I'll show you around.
Show you around means be their guide.
lines.zh: show you around 是當對方的導遊。

lines.say: Even if they never come, they'll remember the invitation.
lines.zh: 就算對方從來沒去，也會記得這個邀請。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: You should come and visit some time. I'll show you around.
Is it true everyone in Taiwan eats rice every day?
lines.zh: 台灣是不是每個人每天都吃飯？

lines.say: Not exactly. It really depends on the family. Is there anything like that in Italy?
lines.zh: 不完全是，其實要看每個家庭。義大利有類似的東西嗎？

lines.say: Well, my nonna made pasta every single day.
lines.zh: 嗯，我奶奶每天都煮義大利麵。

lines.say: No way, my grandma made rice every single day!
lines.zh: 不會吧，我奶奶也每天都煮飯！

lines.say: You should come and visit some time. I'll show you around.
lines.zh: 你哪天應該來玩，我帶你到處逛。

lines.say: Two grandmas, one friendship. Perfect.
lines.zh: 兩個奶奶，一段友誼。完美。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：愛爾蘭式的歡迎

lines.say: One more thing! Irish people are famous for welcoming visitors. Two phrases you'll hear.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！愛爾蘭人以熱情好客出名，教你兩句常聽到的話。

lines.say: This is Irish, the language. You'll see it at airports, pubs and hotels.
lines.zh: 這是愛爾蘭語，在機場、Pub 和飯店都看得到。

lines.say: Céad míle fáilte!
It sounds like kayd meela fawlcha. It means: a hundred thousand welcomes.
lines.zh: 唸起來像 kayd meela fawlcha，意思是：十萬個歡迎。

board.kicker: When you visit an Irish home

lines.say: And the first thing you'll hear in any Irish home is this.
lines.zh: 走進任何愛爾蘭人家裡，第一句一定會聽到這個。

lines.say: You'll have a cup of tea?
It's not really a question. Say yes. The kettle is already on.
lines.zh: 這不算真的在問你。說好就對了，水已經在燒了。

lines.say: You'll have a cup of tea?

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：一整晚的文化交流

lines.say: Now the whole dinner chat. Say Ting's lines!
lines.zh: 現在把整段晚餐聊天演一遍。跟著唸小婷的台詞！

lines.say: So, what's the one food I have to try in Taiwan?
lines.zh: 那在台灣，一定要吃的食物是什麼？

lines.say: You have to try stinky tofu. It smells awful, but it tastes amazing.
lines.zh: 你一定要試試臭豆腐，聞起來很可怕，但吃起來超讚。

lines.say: Stinky? Is it like a strong cheese?
lines.zh: 臭的？像味道很重的起司嗎？

lines.say: Good question! I've never really thought about that. It's the kind of thing you eat at a night market, late at night.
lines.zh: 好問題！我從來沒想過這個。那是你會在夜市、深夜吃的東西。

lines.say: I'm in. When do we go?
lines.zh: 我要去！什麼時候出發？

lines.say: You should come and visit some time. I'll show you around.
lines.zh: 你哪天應該來玩，我帶你到處逛。

lines.say: Well done, Ting! Now everyone at the table wants to visit Taiwan.
lines.zh: 小婷做得好！現在全桌的人都想去台灣了。

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them, and change the details for your own home town.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡。截圖下來，把細節換成你自己的家鄉。

lines.zh: 走之前！想每天都練一點英文嗎？

lines.zh: 試試 BinBin。每天一則你所在地區的短新聞，難的單字都有解釋。

lines.zh: 接著玩快速的單字小遊戲，自己玩或約朋友一起。

lines.say: And bring me some pineapple cake next time! See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 下次記得帶鳳梨酥給我！下一課見，Bye！
